{{Quote|While certainly well equipped and just as effective as reports suggested, the scout trooper platoon has encountered resistance when fitting in with the rest of the Legion.|Intercepted transmission from the 439th Legion|<ref name="TFUIIdb" />}}
The '''439th Legion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Legion/Legends|unit]] in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its organization included a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] that was noted for their inability to integrate with the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|general armed forces]] due to their disdain for other types of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

==History==
{{Quote|The friction is almost entirely on the side of the scouts, who seem to have made a sport of being as difficult and as offensive as possible to anyone of equal or lower rank.|Intercepted transmission from the 439th Legion|<ref name="TFUIIdb" />}}
By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> less than a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the start of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> the 439th [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] was composed of enlisted [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], birth-born [[Human/Legends|Human]] recruits who had largely replaced [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]] as the majority force in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Around the same time, a [[Scout platoon|light infantry]] [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]] was transferred to the 439th Legion on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Although they were reputed to be a well-equipped and effective military [[Division/Legends|division]], the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] were unable to socially integrate with the 439th and soon became the source of much hostility between themselves and the rest of the unit's [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. They shared a strong sense of solidarity with each other, but also made a habit of being extremely abrasive and anti-social toward anyone who was not part of the scout trooper program.<ref name="TFUIIdb" />

In addition to their blatant contempt for other branches of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], the scout troopers began racing on their [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] in the Legion's [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] throughout the night with the intention of disrupting the other troopers' sleep. The regular [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the 439th became aggravated to the point where reports suggested that the scouts needed to be segregated from the rest of the Legion for their own personal safety.<ref name="TFUIIdb" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 439th Legion was mentioned in the Scout Troopers' Databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
